title: Launch a research, prototype or task agent from a ticket
summary: Research, prototype and task tickets on the Tickets screen now carry a Launch button that opens an agent tab running the matching catalogue command; held tickets and tickets with a running agent show it greyed out with the reason.

deferred.what: The ticket list shows no kind badge on its rows, while the prototype's launch state shows one on every row, so a member cannot tell which tickets are research, prototype or task (and so launchable) without opening each one.
deferred.why: Outside this story's scope (In: the control only).
